title: Next.js API route with no auth check
ask: Can a user call this route without logging in?
fix: Check the session at the top of the handler and return 401 when there is no logged-in user.

title: API route reads a record by ID without checking who owns it
ask: Can a logged-in user read or change another user's record just by changing the ID in the URL?
fix: Load the record scoped to the session user (e.g. WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?) and return 404 when it is not theirs.

title: Secret exposed to the browser via NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable
ask: Is a server-only secret being shipped to the browser bundle?
fix: Rename without NEXT_PUBLIC_ and only read it in server code (route handlers, server actions); rotate the exposed secret.

title: Server action without an auth check
ask: Can anyone call this server action directly and act on data that is not theirs?
fix: Server actions are public endpoints: re-check the session and ownership inside every action.
